text.p: Following are the main stories in Monday's Malaysian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

-- The Malaysian government said it is to encourage the use of bicycles and motorcycles in major cities to reduce traffic congestion. It will ultimately going to reduce the amount of parking space in order to make way for larger roads, said Transport Minister Ling Liong Sik on Sunday.
